title: eng hiring & onboarding weekly sync - 2026-03-24
content:
Weekly Hiring & Onboarding Sync - Platform Engineering
Date: 2026-03-24
Owner/Facilitator: Liam Chen
Attendees: Liam Chen, Aisha Kapoor, Ravi Patel, Maya Gomez, Ben Thompson

Agenda:
- Quick pipeline review (open roles / scheduled interviews)
- Interview debriefs (this week)
- Onboarding status for new hires + blockers
- Team health / capacity check
- Action items + owners

1) Pipeline summary
- Open roles: 6 total active (Sr Backend Engineer x2, Infra SRE, Runtime Engineer, Test Automation, Product Engineer).
- Screening stage: ~8 candidates in phone-screen queue.
- Onsite/loop scheduled: 4 candidates this week (2 for Sr Backend, 1 SRE, 1 Runtime).
- Offers outstanding: 1 verbal offer (Sr Backend) waiting for comp approval; target to convert by EOD 2026-03-25.

Recruiting notes:
- Conversion rate from onsites -> offers is trending slightly down (current 40% vs target 55%). Need to check loop consistency and interviewing rubric alignment.
- Interview scheduling friction: engineering calendars are overloaded next two weeks - hiring coordinators flagged limited availability for panelists.

2) Interview debriefs (this week)
- Candidate: Sr Backend (Candidate A) - onsite 2026-03-22
  - Interviewers: Aisha, Ravi, Ben
  - Summary: Strong systems design, relevant infra experience, good ownership examples. Slight mismatch on language stack (Python + Go preferred; candidate mainly Java) but adaptable.
  - Score: 8/10 overall.
  - Recommendation: Move to offer.
  - Blockers: Compensation band confirmation required (submitted to People Ops).

- Candidate: SRE (Candidate B) - onsite 2026-03-23
  - Interviewers: Liam, Maya, Senior SRE partner from SRE team
  - Summary: Excellent incident response examples, good DB ops knowledge, weaker on distributed tracing tooling we use.
  - Score: 7/10
  - Recommendation: Second-technical loop focused on observability (1 hour) before decision.
  - Next step: Maya to schedule follow-up (target 2026-03-27).

- Candidate: Runtime Engineer (Candidate C) - onsite 2026-03-23
  - Interviewers: Ravi, Ben
  - Summary: Good low-level performance optimization experience, familiarity with CUDA bindings, but limited production service ownership examples.
  - Score: 6.5/10
  - Recommendation: Keep in pipeline; consider as strong contractor/short-term hire.

3) Onboarding status for new hires
- New joiners in last 2 weeks:
  - Priya N. (Joined 2026-03-10) - Runtime Engineer
    - Completed: laptop, accounts, initial team orientation, buddy assigned (Ben).
    - In progress: deep-dive training on inference runtime internals scheduled for 2026-03-26.
    - Blockers: access to internal perf test cluster (ticket PLAT-482) - infra flagged a permissions issue.
  - Carlos M. (Joining 2026-03-30) - SRE (offer accepted)
    - Pre-boarding: paperwork complete. Hardware order placed (target arrival 2026-03-29).
    - Ramp plan: first 2 weeks focused on runbooks + on-call shadowing.

Onboarding checklist items outstanding:
- Dev VPN access automation: still 40% manual steps. Action: Aisha to follow up with infra-automation (due 2026-04-02).
- Internal doc updates: "runtime onboarding playbook" needs a short section on KV cache troubleshooting (Ravi assigned; due 2026-03-31).

4) Team health / capacity
- Current headcount: 28 engineers on Platform (2 contractor FTE equivalents). Hiring target for Q2: +6 net hires to reach planned team size.
- Workload signal: several product roadmap tasks deferred last sprint due to interview load and ramping new hires.
- Burnout check: informal pulse - two ICs reported high meeting load and context switching. Recommended: encourage meeting-free blocks and use async updates for status.
- Mentorship: pairing program running; suggest rotate mentors monthly to distribute load and exposure.

5) Risks / blockers
- Offer conversion delay: comp approval queue (Finance/People Ops) causing 48-72h delays; slows candidate momentum.
- Infra permissions bug blocking Priya's perf testing (see PLAT-482).
- Interview rubric drift: several interviewers are giving inconsistent feedback shapes (behavioral vs technical weight). Need a short calibration session.

6) Decisions & proposals
- Proceed with offer for Candidate A (Sr Backend) once comp band confirmed. Liam to escalate to People Ops today.
- Schedule 1-hour observability loop for Candidate B (SRE) before final decision. Maya to own scheduling.
- Approve short-term contractor conversion path for Candidate C if no hire decision by 2026-04-10.

7) Action items
- Liam: Escalate comp approval for Candidate A (target 2026-03-25).
- Maya: Schedule follow-up observability loop for Candidate B (target 2026-03-27).
- Aisha: Follow up with infra-automation on VPN access automation and permissions for perf cluster (tickets: PLAT-482) (target 2026-04-02).
- Ravi: Update runtime onboarding playbook - add KV cache troubleshooting section (target 2026-03-31).
- Ben: Confirm buddy schedule for new hires and create a 1:1 intro template (target 2026-03-28).
- Recruiting: Re-run interviewer calibration checklist and distribute a 1-page rubric cheat sheet to panelists (Recruiter owner: Sarah L. - target 2026-03-30).

Notes / misc:
- Requested addition to Confluence: short how-to for running perf harness locally - Ben to draft.
- Suggestion from team: dedicated hiring cadence window (Tues/Thurs afternoons) to reduce calendar fragmentation; discuss with hiring coordinators next week.

Next sync: 2026-03-31 (same time).
If anything urgent before then, post in #eng-hiring or DM Liam.

Attachments / links: see metadata linked_artifacts for Jira/Confluence/PR references.

End of notes.
